purpose: Independently verify refractory-age observables and preserve the complete regenerative state across checkpointed observation partitions.

semantics.active_process: X=x+mu*t+sigma*W; hit zero, count immediately, wait deterministic refractory, then reset to positive distance
semantics.age_reference: Independent continuous renewal hitting-density integral; existing R12 complete-successor moments crosschecked
semantics.discrete_solver: Positive centered nearest-neighbor forward equation with an explicit deterministic-age queue; spatial upper absorption is metered
semantics.age_bins: Finite-volume age bins uniformly distribute each step's absorbing flux over that step
semantics.checkpoint: Complete active law, age queue and cursor, physical clock and step, accumulated count and loss, model and grid identities
semantics.partition_claim: Bitwise identity only on the same fixed space/time lattice, without rebuilding the mesh at an observation boundary
semantics.unaligned_times: Refuse requests off the fixed time lattice; arbitrary remeshing is not validated
semantics.training_scope: No conclusion about the frozen R12 content gate or any learned recurrent content transition

time_grid: M=ceil(refractory*sigma^2/(0.4*h^2)); dt=refractory/M; H/refractory is exactly six in the registered cases
partition_rule: floor(fraction*total_steps); retain actual integer steps and times
negative_control_scope: Both physical corruptions at every spatial grid; retain their failed equivalence rows and separately require the discrepancy to be detected
failure_policy: Every attempt is a new immutable directory with source snapshots, raw final states, checkpoints, all failures and process metering. No gate is loosened after execution.
not_established: arbitrary change of numerical grid at observation times
zero refractory or initial boundary atom
random, state-dependent or learned moving boundary
training-path integration or neural quality gain
